**Install:** download `reel-saver-*.apk` below on your Android phone and open it. Android asks once to allow installs from your browser or file manager. Each release is signed with the same key, so it installs over the previous one.

**Use:** in Instagram, open a reel, tap the share button, and pick **Reel Saver**. The video lands in **Movies/Reel Saver** in your gallery. Reels from private accounts can't be saved, since Reel Saver never uses your Instagram login.
